description: This file defines the class JacksonSerializationContext, which implements the SerializationContext interface for serializing data into CBOR format using Jackson's JsonGenerator. It manages writing various data types and controls output stream behavior.

classes.name: JacksonSerializationContext
classes.description: Implementation of SerializationContext that uses Jackson's JsonGenerator to serialize data into CBOR format.

classes.name: JacksonSerializationContext.ControllableOutputStream
classes.description: An OutputStream wrapper that can be enabled or disabled to control whether data is written to the underlying stream.

methods.name: JacksonSerializationContext
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the context with a Jackson JsonFactory and an OutputStream or ByteBuffer.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the JsonGenerator and internal resources.

methods.name: writeCachedElement
methods.description: Writes cached byte data to the output stream and informs Jackson that an element was written.

methods.name: writeNumber
methods.description: Overloaded methods to write float, double, long, or int numbers.

methods.name: writeFieldName
methods.description: Writes a field name for JSON object.

methods.name: informJacksonThatOneElementWasWritten
methods.description: Temporarily disables output stream to write a null, then re-enables, to keep internal counters accurate.
